source: Same AI dealer and studio. Pose-matched ten-second waiting take, existing uncut physical placement/turn, and a new natural waiting and physical card collection continuation.
edit: Three ten-second takes joined at matching stationary poses. Restore the 21:9 continuations to the original camera coordinates with unchanged border pixels; no stretching of the dealer. All actions and the six-second result run at native 24fps speed. H.264 faststart, one-second keyframes, 1920x900 desktop and 1280x600 mobile.
presentation: Transparent server-authoritative card ink follows decoded frames through the turn and subsequent collection. 115 offline fingertip masks retain filmed paper, skin and shadows without per-frame pixel processing in the browser. Current result UI clears at the next round; the previous physical card retains its ink until turned toward the discard tray. Background tabs pause playback. Prolonged settlement holds the final result frame without repeated seeks.
